text: A patient asked what to do before a fasting blood test and was told to fast for 10 hours and drink water. The prep note for AP-1057 was shared.
A patient asked about the late cancellation fee and was told it is 25 dollars under 24 hours notice, with the portal as the place to cancel.
A patient asked for a dosing recommendation. The assistant declined and pointed to the patient's clinician and the nurse advice line in the portal.
A patient asked for opening hours at the eastgate site and was given weekday hours, the 16:00 to 17:30 walk-in window and the paid garage note.
A patient asked to check AP-1042 and was told it is confirmed at the north site on 2026-10-14 at 09:30 with Dr. Maren Ostrowski.
A caller asked for a family member's appointment time. The assistant declined and explained that appointments are private.
A patient asked about waitlist status for AP-1078 and was told it is waitlisted and the clinic will call if a slot opens.
A patient asked to renew a prescription in chat. The assistant explained renewals go through the patient portal and take 7 business days.
A patient asked how to book counselling and was told intake is booked only in the patient portal; AP-1085 prep note was explained.
A patient asked about an uninsured visit fee and was told 85 dollars for a standard visit and about payment plans over 200 dollars.
